## Step 3: System Setup  
### Standing Order Creation in AMS/PPS  
**Fields Entered into System:**  
| Field | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Standing Order ID | SO-00001234 | Auto-generated |
| Source Account | ACC-00001 | Customer's account |
| Payee Name | John Smith | Recipient name |
| Payee Account | 12345678 | Recipient's account |
| Payee Sort Code | 20-00-00 | Bank sort code |
| Amount | £500.00 | Fixed amount |
| Frequency | Monthly | Recurrence pattern |
| Start Date | 2026-02-01 | First execution date |
| End Date | None | Ongoing (no end date) |
| Status | Active | Standing order live |
| Created Date | 2026-01-15 | Creation date |
| Created By | Staff ID | Who set it up |

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Creation
raw_entities.description: System setup procedure for creating a standing order in the AMS/PPS platform. Involves entry of standing order details including source account, payee information, amount, frequency, and execution dates. The process results in an active standing order record with auto-generated ID and system tracking.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Data Entry
raw_entities.description: Discrete step where all standing order fields are entered into the AMS/PPS system, including standing order ID, source account, payee details, amount, frequency, and date parameters. This step captures the complete configuration of the standing order before activation.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Setup Staff
raw_entities.description: Operations staff member responsible for entering standing order details into the AMS/PPS system. Identified by Staff ID in the Created By field and performs the data entry step that establishes the standing order record.
context: Created By | Staff ID | Who set it up

raw_entities.name: Standing Order
raw_entities.description: A recurring payment instruction configured with fixed amount of £500.00, monthly frequency, and ongoing duration with no end date. The standing order is created on 2026-01-15 with first execution on 2026-02-01 and maintains Active status in the system.

raw_entities.name: Source Account
raw_entities.description: The customer's account from which the standing order payments are debited. Identified as ACC-00001 in the system and serves as the source for the £500.00 monthly payments.

raw_entities.name: Payee
raw_entities.description: The recipient of the standing order payments, identified as John Smith. Holds the receiving account with sort code 20-00-00 and account number 12345678 to which monthly payments of £500.00 are directed.
context: Payee Name | John Smith | Recipient name
Payee Sort Code | 20-00-00 | Bank sort code
